# Equal-budget LSTM at 72 h and 168 h: tuning on validation (generated by `scripts/run_long_lstm_tuning.py`)

Git commit `ff3757acb8`. LSTM L4, 30 random trials per horizon in the widened space plus the original configuration re-evaluated; selection on validation only. MAE in MW.

## Horizon 72 h

- Original configuration re-evaluated under the trial procedure: 5,368 MW; best of the 30 new trials: 5,466 MW; selected original (hidden 64, lr 0.003244, dropout 0.05, weight decay 4e-05).
- Final validation MAE (3 seeds, early stopping on validation): per-seed mean 5,597 MW (range 5,368-5,715); best epochs [2, 1, 1].

## Horizon 168 h

- Original configuration re-evaluated under the trial procedure: 6,562 MW; best of the 30 new trials: 6,472 MW; selected new#0 (hidden 16, lr 0.0003765, dropout 0.03, weight decay 0.0016).
- Final validation MAE (3 seeds, early stopping on validation): per-seed mean 6,442 MW (range 6,385-6,472); best epochs [1, 1, 1].
